title: Elder Life App
soWhat: A phone companion designed for older adults who are not comfortable with consumer electronics. It brings commonly used functions into one hub — weather and going-out advice, clinic and medication reminders, a magnifier, and AI Q&A.
problem: Routing between the apps on the phone, finding type size and layout that older adults can actually read, and setting up the backend for AI Q&A.
method: Built four areas: transit, medical, daily life, and contacts
Transit page: quick shortcuts into the matching apps for taxi, bus, train, and similar modes
Medical page: nearby clinic search, medication reminders, and follow-up visit reminders
Daily-life page: AI answers to everyday questions, a magnifier, and shortcuts into phone settings
Contacts page: notes and contact-info records
Contacts, reminders, and settings live in an encrypted on-device database (Hive + AES), so the app works without a network
Only the AI Q&A needs the self-hosted backend
Reminders export to a block of text, which can be pasted back in when switching phones or asking family for help
